name: Produce letters, reports and documents from records
summary: Produces letters, reports and documents from records: each record marked ready is copied from its Google Doc template, filled from the record, checked for unfilled fields and logged. The client gets the document only after a person approves the share. Crons read and draft; a person approves every share.

covered_by.request-arrives: intake (a record marked ready in the records tab)
covered_by.pick-template: draft (one template per kind of document)
covered_by.pull-data: intake (the record's columns become the fields)
covered_by.write-or-fill: draft (copy of the template with the fields filled in)
covered_by.check: queue (open comments hold the share; unfilled fields go to a person)
covered_by.send-or-print: approval (shares the Doc; Google emails the client a link)
covered_by.file: draft (the copy is made in the output folder)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (one row per document in the log tab)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New records marked ready in the records tab.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Copy the template for each new record, fill it, check for unfilled fields, log the row.

crons.name: queue
crons.summary: Hold drafts with open comments or no client email; queue the share to the client for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of the records tab and the draft, a copy of a template in the output folder, text filled into that copy, a row in the document log. Sharing a Doc with a client is a live operation and waits for a person.

google-workspace.covers: records tab (read), Doc copy from a template, plain-text fill, comment check, document log row, share to the client after approval

gaps: Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, OneDrive, Outlook): no adapter. The platform evidence maps no operations for it, so templates and shares do not run there yet.
Record sources other than a Google Sheet (Simpro, Xero, Monday.com, Style Arcade, ShiftCare and similar): not mapped here. Ready rows must be put into the records tab first.
PandaDoc: its document operations are mapped in the kit, but the platform evidence has no support rows for this job, so no adapter is built. Worth a go-ahead before building.
Canva (named for template picking): not mapped as a document platform here.

Reports that need judgment (progress reports from quoting ratios, financial commentary, letters that answer a specific question) are agent-skill work. The cron only fills named fields from the record.
Templates are plain Google Docs with {{Header}} placeholders. Tables, images and headers or footers are not filled; a placeholder left in them is not caught.
Drive approvals (drive.approvals.start and related) exist in the ops file but starting one emails the approvers, so it would be a live operation. Not built.
Sharing sends a link, not a PDF attachment. Export to PDF and emailing it with the document are not built.
The status of each document is kept in the workflow store and the log tab, not written back to the records tab.
Comments are checked when the share is queued. A comment added after the approval is queued is not seen before the person approves it.
Signatures (eSignature on a Doc or PDF) are not built.
The google-workspace adapter is tested offline only, against a fake network. It has not been run against a live account.
